prompt: Objective: find why profit fell 20%. What you've learned: revenue is flat. Latest finding: cost of goods sold rose 25% while other costs held steady. What is the best next step?

options.text: Break cost of goods sold down by input to see which rose
options.feedback: Right. COGS explains the decline, so the next step is finding which input moved.

options.text: Find out why revenue stayed flat over the period
options.feedback: Flat revenue didn't cause the drop; COGS did. Follow the finding.

options.text: Check whether overhead costs crept up over the same period
options.feedback: Already answered: other costs held steady.

options.text: Estimate how much a price increase would win back
options.feedback: That jumps to a fix before knowing which cost rose or why.

explanation: COGS rose 25% while revenue and other costs held, so the next step is finding which input of COGS moved.
